text: In Portland, Noa is weary of online dating when a charming man calling himself Steve [flirts with her in a supermarket|trigger|love and desire]. After a few dates she agrees, against her best friend Mollie's advice, to a weekend away, and at his luxury home [he drugs her cocktail|threat|people who kill]. She wakes chained to the floor beside other captive women and learns that he is a butcher who [sells human meat to wealthy cannibals|wants|wealth and ambition], and who means to [keep her alive so her meat stays fresh|rules|it must feed].
